% Pattern: proof/attach/numbered. A statement with two proofs, headed
% "Proof 1" and "Proof 2", after a sentence that announces them.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want prop-1 statement/proposition 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=prop-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=prop-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{prop}{Proposition}
\begin{document}
\begin{prop}
A statement.
\end{prop}
We give two proofs.
\begin{proof}[Proof 1]
A step.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof 2]
Another step.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
